text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Investment Authority studies privatisation of electricity, water and communications services.
- Kuwait Petroleum Corporation raises prices for some oil products.

- Kuwait rejects Iraq's proposal to form an Iraq-Kuwait- Saudi Arabian committee to search for prisoners of war missing since the 1990-91 Gulf crisis. Kuwait says Iraq is still holding 600 people, mostly Kuwaitis.
- Real estate sector leads trade on Kuwait Stock Exchange.
- Kuwait welcomes resumption of Iraqi oil exports.
